expected.name: Garrett Ziegler
expected.description:
Molotov cocktails into Dakota County courthouse, Apple Valley (May 2020). Sentence: 60 months federal prison. Verified via public court/press records: https://patch.com/minnesota/applevalley-rosemount/man-sentenced-molotov-cocktail-attack-apple-valley-wsc-doj

Garrett Patrick Ziegler, 24, of Apple Valley, MN was charged with arson and possession of a Molotov cocktail with co-defendant Fornandous Cortez Henderson for the May 29, 2020 fire at the Dakota County Western Service Center. Officers found Ziegler's car keys in grass near the scene; a search of the registered vehicle recovered Molotov-related items. Sentenced to 60 months federal prison plus 3 years supervised release and $205,872.53 restitution.

operations.research_note: Court order identifies Garrett Patrick Ziegler and register22421-041; official BOP full-name result corroborates identity.
